result:
I reviewed the four AI pages at 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440 wide, fixed five problems, and merged the fixes. On the live site all four pages load with zero failed requests, and a separate reviewer passed the changes.

### ✅ Fixed
- **[Models](/framework/ai/models/)** was broken at every width. Its tables were drawn outside the page, which squeezed the AI header into a 338 px column and put text over it on a phone. It is a normal page again, with one line per table row from 1200 wide up.
- **[Inbox](/framework/ai/)** had a 153 px empty band at the bottom holding only "6 open tasks" and "Inbox · 1". The band is gone and the rail runs to the bottom of the screen.
- **[Sessions](/framework/ai/sessions/)** list now starts higher: its first row is 26% down the screen at 1920 (was 33%) and 29% at 3440 (was 42%). The footer on a phone is 63 px tall instead of 140 px.
- **A session's own page** was titled by its long id; it now shows the session's name (for example "Ultracode").

### ⬜ Left open, written down
- **The Inbox's pinned "Now" card** is 7 days old and still sits at the top, so the Inbox isn't ranked by recency yet. The task already working on Inbox ranking owns this; the details are in [Inbox next](/framework/core/Page/ext/Inbox/doc/next.md).
- **The Coverage tab on a session page** wastes space by putting each prompt in a card inside a card. Noted in [Sessions next](/framework/ai/sessions/doc/next.md).
